keyFindings.description: `docker port` reads NetworkSettings.Ports, cleared when a container stops: a stopped legion-smoke-nats-<slug> can never pass the ownership test, so ensure_nats's `docker start` branch is unreachable after a host reboot and up.sh fails with the misleading 'is not mapped to configured port'; the legacy branch leaves a stopped fixed-name container with the `none` message. Trunk's substring test failed the same way on empty output. Fix: read HostConfig.PortBindings via docker inspect --format inside the same function. Confirmed from docker/cli port.go and moby releaseNetwork by the deep-review agent; no exited container on this host to observe read-only.
docker rm -f unguarded under set -e; a container removed by someone else between the port test and rm aborts before RIG DOWN (harmless).
Unused -n SMOKE_REPO gate documented; owner-whitespace regex accepted; worker_stream_port pin declined by the architect.
